name: Button
summary: A native button with primary, danger and quiet variants, three sizes, and icon-only and toggle forms.

guidance.useFor: Doing something: submitting, saving, opening a dialog, adding to the cart.
insteadUse: Going to another page or place: a Link (style it as a button only when it must look like one)
Turning a setting on and off: Switch, or Toggle button for a pressed state
content: Labels are verbs in sentence case that say what happens: "Continue to payment", "Remove"
One primary per view; danger only for destructive actions, always with a word

rungReason: <button> provides the role, focusability, Enter/Space activation and form participation.

states.note: Use aria-disabled="true" when the button must stay focusable to explain why it is unavailable; then the click handler must ignore activation

enhancements.fallback: Opaque tint; the glass blur is decoration
Ignored where unknown; increased contrast still applies

contrast: Increased contrast (data-theme=*-more, data-contrast=more, prefers-contrast: more) and reduced transparency: opaque fill, solid ring
forcedColors: ButtonFace / ButtonText / ButtonText border; pressed → SelectedItem / SelectedItemText; disabled → GrayText
